Mira Chen: Heads-up — hit a weird JSON-mode + function-call edge in the sample app. Repro below, pretty reproducible on my machine. :bug:
Mira Chen: Setup: JS SDK v0.14.2, Python SDK v0.9.1, model=gpt-x, json_mode=true + schema validator + function/tool calling. Python and hosted tests return a proper object for tool args, but the JS path yields an extra-quoted string that breaks our tool runner.
Mira Chen: Minimal repro payload (trimmed):
```json
{
  "json_mode": true,
  "function_call": "auto",
  "schema": { "type": "object", "properties": { "id": {"type": "integer"} } }
}
```
Mira Chen: When auth=normal it works. When auth auto-refresh triggers (401 -> refresh -> retry) the JS SDK seems to re-serialize the function args and ends up with double-encoding. Raw tool message we got: `{"role":"tool","name":"get_user","content":"\"{\\\"id\\\":123,\\\"meta\\\":{\\\"src\\\":\\\"ok\\\"}}\""}` — note the nested quotes.
Raf Patel: yikes. which auth middleware do you have? our retry wrapper or the SDK built-in?
Mira Chen: We use our in-house middleware that refreshes token then retries the original request. The lifecycle looks like: request -> 401 -> refresh -> retry(original payload).
Nate Williams: I think I’ve seen something similar: if serialization happens lazily in the SDK and the retry clones the already-stringified body, you can end up double-stringifying. Workaround: make the transport layer idempotent or stringify only once at send.
Raf Patel: Can you paste the SDK request/response logs (raw wire) + the exact SDK version? Also does disabling json_mode change outcome?
Mira Chen: Quick logs: 
> SEND (post): {json_mode:true, function_call:auto} -> body payload (js-sdk): `{\"function_call\":\"auto\",\"args\":\"{\\\"id\\\":123}\"}`
> MODEL RESP: returns object as usual, but the SDK helper that constructs tool args runs again on retry and treats a string as "already safe" so it adds quotes.
Mira Chen: Disabling json_mode makes the problem go away (we just get plain text that we parse differently).
Nate Williams: Short-term workaround: in your middleware, on retry rehydrate the original parsed object instead of reusing the possibly-stringified copy. Or turn off the SDK's json coercion for that call.
Anya K: Filing INC-3921 with repro + logs. I'll branch a hotfix to stop the SDK helper from re-serializing on retry. Assigning @Mira Chen to validate the fix.
devx-bot: CI kicked: https://ci.redwood/example/1965/build/1234 — running integration tests that reproduce the sample-app flow.
Raf Patel: Longer term we should move final serialization to a single place (transport) and make retry clone strictly before serialization. I'll add an RFC.
Mira Chen: Thanks all — will try Nate's short-term workaround, validate hotfix when ready, and add an automated integration test to prevent regressions. :+1:
Anya K: I'll also add a lint rule so sample-apps can't enable both json_mode + mutable middleware without an explicit opt-in.
Mira Chen: Assigning myself to INC-3921 and adding notes to the sample-app README. Thanks everyone! :raised_hands:
